## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b528a2e092c61631c8f031cc4819a44e58b2d48d`
Local-runs: none

Inputs, and nothing else: card #22678 (body, claim `6100296545`, dev report `6100561974`); ruling `6097072172` on #22590 with that thread (15 comments; the dev report `6095496633`, the decision request `6095537369` and the card-filing `6097212566` read in full); PR #22707's body, file list and net diff against `main` (`origin/main` = `61bea242`, merge base `d8830c28`); the 35 check-runs on the head. Every tree claim below was read on `origin/main` with `git show` / `git grep`; nothing was built, run or re-run. The PR is a draft and `docs/adr/**` is Tier H: this record informs the maintainer's word and lifts nothing by itself.

### ① Derived judgments

**What the diff implies.** Three files, +277 / −1, all under `docs/adr/`: one new record (`0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md`, 275 lines, Proposed) and one pointer line each on ADR-0055 and ADR-0056. No package path, no `packages/spec`, no driver, no `.changeset/`, no `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry. Accept-set change: none. Public-surface change: none. Governed surface: `docs/adr/**` → Tier H; the PR is a draft; no seat merges, queues or arms it. `main` moved `d8830c28` → `61bea242` since the dev's reading; the diff between those two commits touches none of the paths the record cites (empty over `docs/adr` and every cited package directory), so the dev's readings are current.

**Scope against ruling `6097072172`** — one engine-internal, non-authorable leaf; nothing wider. Each decision, named:

- **D1** (one branded `$in` comparand, unspellable by a request) — **inside**. The ruling's "one non-authorable filter leaf, never accepted from a request". Tree claims hold: `FieldOperatorsSchema`, `VALID_AST_OPERATORS`, `parseFilterAST` are in `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`; `assertListComparandShapes` refuses a plain object at a comparand position with `INVALID_FILTER` (`packages/objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts`, the predicate at its top and the code at L80); `markFilterSubtreeProvenance` keys on `Symbol.for` and carries `'policy'` (`filter-subtree-provenance.ts`). No new operator, no authorable spelling. Right.
- **D2** (ObjectQL composes from `canReadObject` + `getReadFilter`, fail closed, tenant wall left to the driver) — **inside**. The contract reads as the record says: `ISecurityService` answers a DENY filter on any failure and forbids memoising across requests (`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`, the header and the `getReadFilter` doc); `RLS_DENY_FILTER` exists; `lowerRelationConditions` is the engine seam; `$in: []` is the FALSE identity the relation lowering documents (`relation-filter-lowering.ts`); the analytics door asks both halves over the base object plus every joined object (`service-analytics/src/read-admission.ts`). Right.
- **D3** (`driver-sql` compiles inside `applyTenantScope`; wasm and local Turso inherit; the remote transport compiles; memory implements; mongodb refuses; no capability bit) — **inside** the ruling's "`driver-sql` implements it, the other four drivers implement it or refuse loudly". The tree has exactly five driver packages; `SqliteWasmDriver extends SqlDriver` and `TursoDriver extends SqlDriver` are stated in-tree; `remote-transport.ts` carries its own `buildWhereSQL` compiler; `memory-tenancy-guard.ts` refuses multi-tenant boot; `mongodb-filter.ts#translateFilter` exists. The 17.0.0 retirement text for `querySubqueries` / `joins` is quoted verbatim from `driver.zod.ts` (L350–357). Right. One deliberate narrowing to name: the decision request's option-A text (`6095537369`) said the driver contract "re-declares what 17.0.0 retired"; the ruling itself requires no bit, and the record's compile-or-refuse shape satisfies "implement it or refuse loudly" under ADR-0049's reasoning. Inside scope; flagged in ③ for the maintainer's eye.
- **D4** (six consumers emit one leaf per parent object, no pre-scan; `changed_fields` column with a backfill) — **inside**: the ruling names the six and the column. All six gate symbols resolve; `PARENT_GATE_SCAN_LIMIT = 2_000` (`parent-record-read-gate.ts` L68), the comment gate's `READ_SCAN_LIMIT = 2_000` (`comment-access-hooks.ts` L197), the attachment gate's own `READ_SCAN_LIMIT = 2_000` (`attachment-access-hooks.ts` L731); the pre-scan reads with `{ isSystem: true }` and no tenant (`parent-record-read-gate.ts` L186–191); `isWithheldOnlyUpdate` judges `metadata.old` / `metadata.new`; `sys_activity` is `managedBy: 'append-only'`; `migrateStoredMetadataBodyCopies`, `AUDIT_EXCLUDED_OBJECTS` and `diff` exist where cited. Right — with one mis-attribution, (a) below.
- **D5** (three classes stay on the bounded probe: delegated caller, middleware-gated parent, federated parent) — **inside**: the ruling names exactly these three. Verified to the line: `getReadFilter` returns `RLS_DENY_FILTER` for an `onBehalfOf` context with the in-tree comment "the D10 delegator intersection is NOT implemented on this path … FAIL CLOSED" (`security-plugin.ts`, inside `getReadFilter`); the object-scoped read gates are registered exactly as listed — `{ object: 'sys_attachment' }`, `{ object: COMMENT_OBJECT }` / `COMMENT_REACTION_OBJECT`, `{ object }` = `sys_approval_request` (`request-read-gate.ts#bindVisibilityGate`), `{ object: ACTIVITY_OBJECT }`, `{ object: LEDGER_OBJECT }`; `resolveDatasourceBinding` exists and `ObjectQL.LIFECYCLE_DATASOURCE = 'telemetry'`; ADR-0057 §3.6 is the datasource split. Right. Note, not a defect: the recognition rule as written ("`registerMiddleware` with an `object`") is wider than the list — `hasObjectMiddleware` does not distinguish read from write middleware, so `sys_user_position` and `sys_permission_set` (write-side registrations in `security-plugin.ts`) also fall in the class; that errs to the bound, the direction the record itself chooses.
- **D6** (ADR-0055 row (a) and ADR-0056's non-goal reversed for this one leaf; the compiler gains no form) — **inside**. The quoted texts are verbatim on `origin/main`: ADR-0055 L50 (row (a)), L73 (the known limit), ADR-0056 L169 (the non-goal); the alternatives table does sit in ADR-0055 §2 (L37–53). Right.
- **Measurements** (5,042 rows; 1,808 readable; 1,105 served and `total` 1,105; administrator at exactly 2,000; the warning on every read; `main` `1b99388505`) — match report `6095496633` exactly. Right.
- **Number 0139** — `origin/main` holds 0137 and 0138, no 0136, no 0139; max+1 is right.
- **The two pointers** — ADR-0055's is a continuation of its status line; ADR-0056's is on its non-goal bullet (L169), not its status line.

**Claims that do not hold as written — three, none moves a decision:**

- **(a) L177–178** — `#isWithheldOnlyUpdate` is written as a continuation after `objects/sys-activity.object.ts#sys_activity`; the symbol is `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-field-redaction.ts#isWithheldOnlyUpdate` (L228). The anchor grammar inherits a path only from an anchor earlier on the SAME line and silently drops a continuation that opens its line (`scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`, `if (!prior) continue;`), so `check-adr-symbol-anchors` never judged it — the green gate is not evidence here. The same orphan spelling sits at L78 (`#VALID_AST_OPERATORS`), L79 (`#parseFilterAST`) and L205 (`#LIFECYCLE_DATASOURCE`); those three are correct by hand-read but equally unjudged. Wrong, and invisible to the gate.
- **(b) L24, L211** — "the four-form fail-closed RLS compiler" / "whose four forms … are unchanged". The compiler's own doc says its subset "is now broader than the historical four forms" (`rls-compiler.ts#compileExpression`); the wording is inherited from ADR-0055 L89. The load-bearing half — a subquery shape compiles to `null` and fails closed — holds. Stale descriptor.
- **(c) L215, L259–260** — "Each record carries one status-line pointer" / "the two status-line pointers it carries". ADR-0056's pointer is on its non-goal bullet, not its status line; the PR body describes the placement correctly, the record's own acceptance criterion does not. The claim is about the diff, and it is inexact.

### ② Semver level

The diff publishes nothing from any released package: three Markdown files under `docs/adr/`, no `.changeset/` entry, no package path. The `skip-changeset` label is present and is the right declaration for this class (⛔ not a bug fix in a released package). Check Changeset: success. Body line 2 reads `Clause-②: no` with no arm, which is right for a diff with no accept-set and no export change — the leaf it decides is non-authorable and nothing of it lands here. Matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags** (report `6100561974`): (1) number 0139, not 0136 — answered above, right; (2) 275 lines against a suggested 250 — answered: the overage is the six-consumer table, the seven-row execution plan the ruling requires and D5's three classes; nothing cuts without dropping a ruling-required item; (3) the commit-trailer pair — not this review's surface. `open_questions: []`. The three `out_of_scope_findings` are noted-not-filed, correctly under Prime Directive #10: a stale path in an agent-read table, a 5,000-row grant read with no warning (carried as the record's O4), and a card attribution — none is a reproducible defect, a contract violation or an authoring trap on its own.
- **The record's O1–O5**: each is marked non-blocking and bound to an execution card; O3 (mongodb refuses until measured) and D5.3 (a `telemetry`-split deployment keeps letter C for the activity stream) are limits the maintainer should read as such — the 维护者速读 names both.
- **Escalated to the maintainer** (Tier H): the narrowing in D3 (no `DriverCapabilities` bit returns, where the decision request's option-A text re-declared one) — inside the ruling's letter, a deliberate choice, theirs to confirm.
- **Check-runs on the head**: all 35 concluded — 24 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Type Check · workspace` and `Test Core (1/6)` were in progress at the dev's report and have since concluded success. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`: success. Green is necessary; it carries no information on (a)–(c), which no gate reads.

**Why FAIL, and what clears it.** D1–D6 are inside the ruling's scope, the quotes and measurements are exact, and every tree claim that bears on a decision holds. What fails is the record as text to be approved: one mechanism pointer names the wrong file and the gate cannot see it (a), one descriptor is stale (b), and the record's own acceptance criterion describes a pointer the diff does not carry (c). A governed record goes to the maintainer correct, not with known errors for them to spot. The fix is three edits on the dev's branch — re-anchor L178 as `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-field-redaction.ts#isWithheldOnlyUpdate` and spell L78, L79 and L205 as full `path#symbol` anchors so the gate judges them; drop "four-form" at L24 and L211 (or say "closed form set, historically four"); at L215 and L259–260 say "one pointer each: ADR-0055's status line, ADR-0056's non-goal bullet". The re-review on the fixed head is a wording check; nothing else in this record needs re-deriving.

Head-sha: `f87ef2345a81297eee220c96b9048f7bedc57ed0`

Re-review on the fixed head, after contract review `6100682640` (FAIL on `b528a2e092`, three wording items (a)–(c)) and the dev's two wording rounds (reports `6100837448`, `6100992444`). Inputs, and nothing else: card #22678 (body and all five comments: the claim `6100296545`, the three dev reports, the seat's REWORK `6100692842`); ruling `6097072172` on #22590 with that thread (15 comments, read in full); PR #22707's body, its one comment (the earlier record), its file list, its four commits and the net diff against `main` (merge base `9f159397fb`; `origin/main` = `c63028e5bf` at this read); the check-runs on the head. Every tree claim below was read on `origin/main` with `git show` / `git grep`; nothing was built, run or re-run. The PR is a draft and `docs/adr/**` is Tier H: this record informs the maintainer's word and lifts nothing by itself. The whole record is judged on this head, not only the three items.

### ① Derived judgments

**What the diff implies.** Three files, +287 / −1, all under `docs/adr/`: the new record `0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md` (285 lines, Proposed) and one pointer line each on ADR-0055 (a continuation of its status line) and ADR-0056 (on its non-goal bullet). No package path, no `packages/spec`, no driver, no `.changeset/`, no `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry (none is owed: the record implements nothing). Accept-set change: none. Public-surface change: none. Governed surface: `docs/adr/**`, Tier H; the PR is a draft; no seat merges, queues or arms it. `main` moved one commit since the merge base (`c63028e5bf`, metadata-protocol search exposure plus one plugin-approvals test); it touches no path the record cites, so every reading below is current.

**The three items from `6100682640`, each on this head:**

- **(a) CLEARED.** The `isWithheldOnlyUpdate` pointer (now L184) is `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-field-redaction.ts#isWithheldOnlyUpdate`, and that symbol is declared at L228 of that file on `origin/main`. The three references the first record named as orphan continuations (`VALID_AST_OPERATORS` L79, `parseFilterAST` L80, `LIFECYCLE_DATASOURCE` L212) are full `path#symbol` anchors. Round 2 went further than asked and spelled the nine remaining line-opening continuations in full (D1, D2, D3, D4, Context, E3/E5). On this head the record carries 54 anchor spans: 49 full anchors and 5 same-line continuations (`#LEDGER_AUDIT_CAPABILITY` L66, `#READ_SCAN_LIMIT` L70, `#joins` L81, `#VALID_AST_OPERATORS` L113, `#compileExpression` L220), each with a full anchor earlier on its own line, which is the one continuation form the grammar in `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs` inherits a path from. A scan for a backticked `#symbol` opening a line finds zero. All 46 distinct targets resolve on `origin/main`: 42 symbol anchors to a declaration in the named file (`canReadObject` is the optional method at `security-service.ts` L793, `compileExpression` the method at `rls-compiler.ts` L1125, `sys_activity` the `name:` at `sys-activity.object.ts` L20) and 4 file-level anchors to a tracked file. Nothing in the record is now outside what the anchor gate judges.
- **(b) CLEARED.** "four-form" is gone at both sites. L24 reads "the fail-closed RLS compiler and its closed pushdown form set (historically four, broader today)"; D6 (L218) reads the same and adds "`#compileExpression`: a subquery shape compiles to `null` and fails closed". That is the compiler's own doc on `origin/main` (`rls-compiler.ts` L1112–1116: "the supported subset is now broader than the historical four forms … a non-pushdownable shape (subquery, …) → `null` → compileFilter fails closed"). ADR-0055's own L89 still says "four-form"; that is ADR-0055's text, untouched by this diff, and the record no longer repeats it.
- **(c) CLEARED.** D6 (L224–225) reads "Each record carries one pointer to this one … ADR-0055's status line, ADR-0056's non-goal bullet"; the acceptance criterion (L269–270) reads "the one pointer each it carries: ADR-0055's status line … and ADR-0056's non-goal bullet". The diff carries exactly that: ADR-0055 gains a line continuing its `**Status**` paragraph (L4), ADR-0056's non-goal bullet (L169) gains a trailing clause, and nothing else in either file moves.

**The two rounds changed nothing else.** The `b528a2e092`→head diff on the record is anchor spelling and re-wrapping, the compiler descriptor, the `#compileExpression` citation, and the two pointer sentences; no decision sentence, measurement, quotation or table row moved. So D1–D6 are re-judged on this head with the first record's tree facts re-read, and each is named:

- **D1** (one branded `$in` comparand, unspellable by a request) — **inside** the ruling's "one non-authorable filter leaf, never accepted from a request". `FieldOperatorsSchema`, `VALID_AST_OPERATORS`, `parseFilterAST` are in `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`; `assertListComparandShapes` is in `packages/objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts`; `markFilterSubtreeProvenance` in `filter-subtree-provenance.ts`. No new operator, no authorable spelling. Right.
- **D2** (ObjectQL composes from `canReadObject` + `getReadFilter`, fail closed, tenant wall left to the driver) — **inside**. `ISecurityService` (L406), `canReadObject` (L793) and `getReadFilter` (L447) are the contract in `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`; `RLS_DENY_FILTER` is exported at `rls-compiler.ts` L680; `lowerRelationConditions` is the engine seam; `read-admission.ts` exists in `service-analytics`. Right.
- **D3** (`driver-sql` compiles inside `applyTenantScope`; wasm and local Turso inherit; the remote transport compiles; memory implements; mongodb refuses; no capability bit) — **inside** "`driver-sql` implements it, the other four drivers implement it or refuse loudly". `packages/drivers/` holds exactly five packages; `SqliteWasmDriver extends SqlDriver` (L67) and `TursoDriver extends SqlDriver` (L1586); `RemoteTransport` (L988), `translateFilter` (L916), `memory-tenancy-guard.ts` exist; `querySubqueries` (L350) and `joins` (L356) are `retiredKey` in `driver.zod.ts` with the quoted words. Right. The deliberate narrowing (no `DriverCapabilities` bit returns, where the decision request's option-A text re-declared one) stands as the first record read it: inside the ruling's letter, flagged in ③.
- **D4** (six consumers emit one leaf per parent object, no pre-scan; `changed_fields` column with a backfill) — **inside**: the ruling names the six and the column. `PARENT_GATE_SCAN_LIMIT = 2_000` (`parent-record-read-gate.ts` L68, whose own doc says "the comment gate's bound", which is what the record's "reused" at L60 means), the comment gate's `READ_SCAN_LIMIT = 2_000` (L197), the attachment gate's own `READ_SCAN_LIMIT = 2_000` (L731); `sys_activity` is `managedBy: 'append-only'` (L25); `AUDIT_EXCLUDED_OBJECTS` (L253), `diff` (L383), `migrateStoredMetadataBodyCopies` (L370) are where cited. Right, and the mis-attribution from (a) is gone.
- **D5** (three classes stay on the bounded probe) — **inside**: the ruling names exactly these three. `security-plugin.ts#getReadFilter` (L6040) returns `RLS_DENY_FILTER` for an `onBehalfOf` context with the in-tree "D10 delegator intersection is not implemented" message (L6079–6087); the object-scoped registrations are as listed (`{ object: 'sys_attachment' }` L787 of `attachment-access-hooks.ts`, `COMMENT_OBJECT` / `COMMENT_REACTION_OBJECT` L808–809 of `comment-access-hooks.ts`, `ACTIVITY_OBJECT` L147, `LEDGER_OBJECT` L163); `resolveDatasourceBinding` (L10156) and `LIFECYCLE_DATASOURCE = 'telemetry'` (L10017) are in `engine.ts`; ADR-0057 §3.6 exists (L264). Right. The first record's note stands and is not a defect: the recognition rule as written is wider than the list and errs to the bound, the direction the record chooses.
- **D6** (ADR-0055 row (a) and ADR-0056's non-goal reversed for this one leaf; the compiler gains no form) — **inside**. Row (a) and the known limit are verbatim on `origin/main` ADR-0055 (L50, L73); the non-goal verbatim on ADR-0056 (L169). Right, and now exact about the pointers, (b) and (c) above.
- **Measurements** (5,042 / 1,808 / 1,105 and `total` 1,105 / administrator at 2,000 / warning on every read / `main` `1b99388505`) — match report `6095496633`. **Number 0139** — `origin/main` holds 0137 and 0138, no 0136, no 0139; max+1 is right. **Cross-references** — ADR-0052 §5 and ActivityPointer, ADR-0090 D10, ADR-0096 D5, ADR-0053 D-D1, ADR-0057 §3.6 all exist where cited.

No claim in the record is found wrong on this head.

### ② Semver level

The diff publishes nothing from any released package: three Markdown files under `docs/adr/`, no `.changeset/` entry, no package path. The `skip-changeset` label is present and is the right declaration for this class (not a bug fix in a released package). Body line 1 `Fixes #22678`, line 2 `Clause-②: no` with no arm, right for a diff with no accept-set and no export change; the leaf the record decides is non-authorable and nothing of it lands here. `Check Changeset` reads `skipped` on this head, which is `pr-automation.yml`'s own opt-out on that label, not a verdict; the diff itself is the evidence. Matches.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags, all three rounds.** Round 0 (`6100561974`): number 0139 not 0136, 285 lines against a suggested 250 (the six-consumer table, the seven-row plan the ruling requires and D5's three classes), the model-free trailer pair; the first two answered right above, the third not this review's surface. Round 1 (`6100837448`): nine orphan continuations left outside the three-item fence; four PR-body sentences gone stale. Round 2 (`6100992444`): the nine are spelled in full, and the body now names head `f87ef2345a`, 2306 anchors and 285 lines (the body's `updated_at` follows the push). Both answered. `deviations: none` in rounds 1 and 2; `open_questions: []` in all three rounds, nothing to escalate from them. `out_of_scope_findings`: round 0's three (a stale path in `compile-surfaces.md`; `sharing-service.ts` grant reads at `limit: 5000`, L507 and L584, carried as the record's O4; a card attribution for `RELATION_FILTER_ID_CAP`, which is at `relation-filter-lowering.ts` L84 as the record says) are noted-not-filed, correctly under Prime Directive #10; round 1's one (the nine continuations) is discharged by round 2; round 2 reports none.
- **The record's O1–O5** are each non-blocking and bound to an execution card; O3 (mongodb refuses until measured) and D5.3 (a `telemetry`-split deployment keeps letter C for the activity stream) are limits for the maintainer to read as such, and the 维护者速读 names both.
- **Escalated to the maintainer** (Tier H, unchanged from the first record): the D3 narrowing, no `DriverCapabilities` bit where the decision request's option-A text re-declared one, inside the ruling's letter, a deliberate choice, theirs to confirm or reverse on the approval.
- **Check-runs on the head, at this record's read:** 38 runs, 26 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure, **1 in progress: `Lint & Repo Gates`** (the job that carries `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`). Not waited for. Concluded success: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Documentation Links` (`check-adr-links`), `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Test Core` 1/6–6/6, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Check PR Size`, the four card-and-claim guards. Skipped by path or label: `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Check Changeset`, the opt-in smoke. The anchor question `Lint & Repo Gates` will answer is the one ① answered by hand on `origin/main`, every span, and nothing in the diff reaches any other gate in that job; the seat that acts next reads its conclusion, and a red there reopens this record.

**Why PASS.** D1–D6 stay inside ruling `6097072172`, the quoted rulings, measurements and ADR texts are exact, every tree claim holds on `origin/main`, and the three wording items that failed the first record are each cleared on this head with no decision text moved. The record now goes to the maintainer without a known error in it. What it needs next is not a seat act: the maintainer's APPROVED review on this PR (Tier H), after which the owning seat lands it and cuts E1–E7 in the record's order; the PR stays a draft until then.

## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #22707 · ADR-0139 · head `f87ef2345a`

`domain:engine` 席 1(#6367)· `session_01JfJfBUC3cQ6hhgm9MQK76T` · 2026-10-10T19:06Z。席位对照自己读的 diff 校正了草稿,并填好席位意见。

**改了什么:** 新增 ADR-0139(状态 Proposed),把你 10 月 10 日「同意」的方案 A 写成正式决策:引擎内部加**一个**过滤叶子,含义是「这个调用者能读的 X 对象 id」。它不可编写,请求里永远拼不出来。ObjectQL 用 `canReadObject` 与 `getReadFilter` 组合读范围,下推成对父表的子查询;driver-sql 编译它,其余驱动编译或响亮拒绝。六个树内消费者(动态、审计台账、撤回更新规则、评论、表情、附件)改用它,撤回更新规则改为写入时盖一列 `changed_fields` 并回填。三类(委托上下文、自带插件读闸的父对象、跨数据源父对象)保留今天的有界探针。ADR-0055 与 ADR-0056 各加一行指针。本 PR 只有文档,不改代码、spec 或驱动;执行卡 E1–E7 批准后才立。

**为什么改:** 实测一位普通成员应看到 1,808 条动态,系统只给 1,105 条,「总数」也显示 1,105;管理员恰好被截在 2,000 条。原因是六处读闸都靠一个 2,000 行的预扫描窗口,多组织部署下所有组织的行挤同一个窗口。ADR-0055 当年明确拒绝过子查询,按基本指令第 13 条,反转一个已记录的决定需要新 ADR,所以文档先于代码。
